description: Multi-tier: memory leak -> OOMKilled -> 503 service unavailable
evidence_text: Workload reporting in namespace multi-agent: resource probe z_mem=5.1 with RSS growing linearly +120MB/h over 6h. state probe: pod reporting-7f9 was OOMKilled 4 times (restartCount=4, exit code 137) and is now in CrashLoopBackOff. app_log: the reporting endpoint returns HTTP 503 service unavailable during restart windows. Memory leak at the resource tier drives OOMKill at the state tier, surfacing as 503 at the app tier.
